notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36812856/50d16d3d024412c030ea3358b939fda3df0512fd.png[/img]

General fixes:
1. Added M hotkey that opens the global map if the player has it in their inventory.
2. Battle dance buffed, atk modifier is now 0.9 instead of 0.7.
3. Earth amulet (legendary) has a new effect. When equipped it gives the wearer Softening spell (makes enemies vulnerable to Earth spells).

Green Furies DLC:
1. Common enemies weakened (but not bosses). Stats weren't changed but now there can only be three scorpions in one group. Groups of four spiders are now a rare encounter.
2. Legendary artefact Gmyrmork amulet has a new effect. When equipped it gives the wearer Softening spell (makes enemies vulnerable to Earth spells).
3. Corrected monster placing zones. Now they won't attack during citrine mining or during story dialogues.
4. Added some new equipment to the goblin dungeon, e.g. a Hunting bow +1 for Gloosha.

notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36812856/b15fd871ea18589849617c08633a1bf78bbb485a.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=9dlcLEwpABQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The game has got a major update v1.5.[/b]

[b]With the 1.5 update introduced, the demo now contains Act I (full version), except for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1511510/Green_Furies/]Green Furies DLC.[/url][/b] The Heroines of Swords & Spells demo is also available on Steam, but buying the game will give you access to achievements, cards and other community items, and also will be of great help to me.

[i]The main changes:[/i]
1) New large portraits by Tr0yka, our artist (main characters only);
2) New cutscenes by Tr0yka;
3) Slightly reworked the balance. E.g. Meat Shield state is now removed by Fear. This means that Anastasia will no longer be able to cover her friends when she's in frightened state
4) Several game maps (mostly streets) were redrawn.
5) The English version of the game has undergone through some changes too. A number of hard-to-pronounce Slavic names and places have been adapted for the English speaking. For example, the surname "Strizhinsky" is now translated as "the Swifts". Anastasia Strizhinskaya became Anastasia Swift, and Strizhinsk was changed to Swifton. Being the creator of this world, this decision was not an easy one for me, but hopefully the adaptation of difficult to pronounce Russian names will make it easier for people to understand and enjoy the game.

[url=https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1064999/1064999_original.png][img]https://ic.pics.livejournal.com/kirillkrm/30093132/1064999/1064999_original.png[/img][/url]

Also on April 15th a DLC called Green Furies is going to be released. The DLC is not free, but the price is quite a bargain.
The DLC includes a separate game scenario about the four evil, greedy, but cute (in their own way) goblinettes. An 'anti-heroic' team of rival protagonists.

The Green Furies scenario should take around 7+ hours to finish. As with the main campaign, the main emphasis in the DLC is on the story, jokes and dialogues. The player will have to read a lot and, of course, understand what is written.
Anyone who decides to go down the wrong path of anti-heroism with the goblinettes should expect:
1. Four new playable characters, each with unique personality traits that affect gameplay;
2. New story and side quests with a variety of playthrough options;
3. A small but ready to be explored goblin cave;
4. Engaging bosses and some original equipment.

I have to note that the DLC scenario is designed for experienced players who are familiar with the story of the main campaign, the world lore and gameplay mechanics. If you haven't played Heroines of Swords & Spells, rushing to buy Green Furies DLC may not be the best decision as far as I'm concerned, but it’s still up to you.

notes.title: 1.1 Update is out! Long-awaited Steam badges are finally here. Enjoy!
notes.content:
Good news, everyone! Guess who got brand new trading cards today? You, that’s who!
Heroines of Swords & Spells (finally) updated to ver. 1.1

What’s new:
1.    Steam community now has HoSS trading cards and all the bells and whistles like emoticons, badges, yada-yada… so you can hoard them like a dragon or share like you care.
2.    The help menu interface suffered some changes and got better.
3.    You can leave Temple of Laverna without defeating the boss now.
4.    Mimic now has a new look (by Avery).
5.    Last (hopefully) batch of minor bugs and typos was dealt with.

I'm happy to announce that the project is finally complete and ready (unless something extraordinary happens) to be ported to the other platforms. I’ll keep you updated through the community groups. Act II is well underway and I have a lot of big ideas and improvements in mind, but the work has just begun, so the game will not be out anytime soon. I'm preparing a small gift for you, however, and I sincerely hope you get to enjoy it by the end of this year. Ho-ho-ho!

notes.title: Version 1.07
notes.content:
Update 1.07. The list of major changes:
1.	Heroines sprites updated. Credits to Promestein. If they receive a warm welcome one of the next patches will change all NPC’s sprites to the similar looking ones. 
2.	Added surrender option to the battle menu. Now you can Surrender in a hopeless fight than you can’t retreat from. To use it press Esc (same as Retreat).
3.	Boss goblins’ Attack, Defense, Luck and HP increased. Ordinary goblins’ stats are the same.
4.	Diana’s kind big heart grew bigger (when certain conditions are met your coin purse can lose а whooping sum of 1500 coins).
5.	Corrected all known bugs and typos (including the elder bug with the elemental in the city sewers). 
If you reported a bug but it’s still present after this patch there’s a high chance I’ve forgotten about it. Sorry! Please be kind to inform me one more time.

notes.title: Version 1.04
notes.content:
Good news, everyone! It’s been a week since Heroines of Swords & Spells was released and everything’s smooth as silk. You bought more than 500 copies of the game and it might not seem that great, but it kinda is. Well, at least in my book. Alas, most of the players are from Russia, although there are several English-speaking players and they even review the game (thank you from the bottom of my heart!). This makes me a bit sad, so if you have friends abroad, please tell them about my game.

Moving on to the patch notes. The game was updated to ver. 1.04: 
- Minor mapping fixes: some passable tiles are now impassable.
- Less typos. 
- Added an in-game notice near the point of no return (after which you will not be able to complete side quests anymore.

I am currently working on 1.05 patch because I received several letters asking about the possibility of going back to playing after finishing the main quest to walk around and finish all remaining quests. There’s a hitch, though. As I am planning to transfer your progress to Act II, I need the game to end at a predetermined point (it wouldn’t work any other way). So the post-main quest gameplay is… well… special, and let’s leave it at that. 

Anyway, I’d like to thank everyone who bought the game and especially those who wrote a review. I’ll keep on fixing errors, but there will not be any content patches as I’m moving on to work on Act II. I hope you’ll keep supporting the game and are as excited about what happens next as I am!
